initialExam.title: KVS PGT (Post Graduate Teacher) 2026
initialExam.description: KVS PGT recruitment for teaching Classes 11-12 in Kendriya Vidyalayas across India.
initialExam.syllabus: Part-I: Hindi, English, GK, Reasoning, Computer (50Q). Part-II: Subject-specific at PG level (100Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 150 questions, 150 marks, 3 hours. Demo Teaching + Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Demo Teaching → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Post Graduate Teacher in Kendriya Vidyalayas
initialExam.careerGrowth: PGT → Vice Principal → Principal → Deputy Commissioner → Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit kvsangathan.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Summer/Winter vacation, Children Education
